name: 06076 · Stafford Spgs, CT
findings: ZIP 06076 (Stafford Spgs) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06076 (Stafford Spgs) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
